title: AdminLock
description: AdminLock is a lightweight and powerful security plugin designed to prevent operator (OP) abuse and protect your server from unauthorized admin commands.
body:
🛡️ **AdminLock – Advanced Admin Monitoring & Anti-Abuse Plugin**

AdminLock is a lightweight and powerful administration plugin designed to **monitor, log, and audit operator commands** on your Minecraft server. It helps server owners maintain **transparency, security, and accountability** within their staff team.

✨ **Key Features**

* 📜 Logs all operator commands with timestamps and executor details
* 👁️ Real-time command spy with live chat notifications
* 👥 View online/offline operators and their locations
* 💾 YAML-based persistent storage with auto-save
* ⚙️ Fully asynchronous and performance-optimized
* 🔍 Paginated command history for easy review

🎮 **Commands**

* `/admin commands <player|console> [page]` – View command history
* `/admin spy <player|stop>` – Monitor commands live
* `/admin op` – List all server operators
* `/admin help` – View help menu

🔧 **Configuration**

* Easily customize which commands are tracked via `config.yml`
* Supports monitoring both player and console commands

🎯 **Use Cases**

* Server owners auditing staff actions
* Training new moderators
* Investigating suspicious activity
* Maintaining trust and transparency

📌 **Technical Info**

* Minecraft Version: Paper / Spigot 1.21+
* Language: Java
* Dependencies: None
* Storage: YAML

🚀 **Installation**

1. Download the plugin JAR
2. Place it in the `plugins` folder
3. Restart the server
4. Use `/admin help` to get started

⭐ **Why AdminLock?**

* Lightweight and reliable
* Clean and professional output
* No performance impact
* Complete admin activity tracking

**AdminLock — Because admin power should always be accountable.**
